text_en: To the leader. A Psalm of David.
The heavens are telling the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims his handiwork.
text_cn: 高天陈述天主的光荣， 穹苍宣扬他手的化工；

text_en: Day to day pours forth speech, and night to night declares knowledge.
text_cn: 日与日侃侃而谈， 夜与夜知识相传。

text_en: There is no speech, nor are there words; their voice is not heard;
text_cn: 不是语，也不是言， 是听不到的语言；

text_en: yet their voice goes out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In the heavens he has set a tent for the sun,
text_cn: 它们的声音传遍普世， 它们的言语达于地极。 天主在天为太阳 设置了帷帐，

text_en: which comes out like a bridegroom from his wedding canopy, and like a strong man runs its course with joy.
text_cn: 它活像新郎一样走出了洞房， 又像壮士一样欣然就道奔放。

text_en: Its rising is from the end of the heavens, and its circuit to the end of them; and nothing is hid from its heat.
text_cn: 由天这边出现，往天那边旋转， 没有一物可以避免它的热焰。

text_en: The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul; the decrees of the Lord are sure, making wise the simple;
text_cn: 上主的法律是完善的，能畅快人灵； 上主的约章是忠诚的，能开启愚蒙；

text_en: the precepts of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the Lord is clear, enlightening the eyes;
text_cn: 上主的规诫是正直的，能悦乐心情； 上主的命令是光明的，能烛照眼睛；

text_en: the fear of the Lord is pure, enduring forever; the ordinances of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
text_cn: 上主的训诲是纯洁的，永远常存； 上主的判断是真实的，无不公允；

text_en: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey, and drippings of the honeycomb.
text_cn: 比黄金，比极纯的黄金更可爱恋； 比蜂蜜，比蜂巢的流汁更要甘甜。

text_en: Moreover by them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.
text_cn: 你仆人虽留心这一切， 竭尽全力遵守这一切，

text_en: But who can detect their errors? Clear me from hidden faults.
text_cn: 但谁能认出自己的一切过犯？ 求你赦免我未觉察到的罪愆。

text_en: Keep back your servant also from the insolent; do not let them have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, and innocent of great transgression.
text_cn: 更求你使你仆人免于自负， 求你不要让骄傲把我占有；如此我将成为完人， 重大罪恶免污我身。

text_en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable to you, O Lord , my rock and my redeemer.
text_cn: 上主，我的磐石，我的救主！愿我口中的话， 并愿我心中的思虑，常在你前蒙受悦纳！
